records.source: Hey, kid. The name's Pam.#$e#Don't be a jerk and we'll get along fine.
records.translation: Uy, bata. Pam ang pangalan ko.#$e#Huwag kang umasal na tarantado at magkakasundo tayo.

records.source: Well I'll be darned... I never expected to get a gift like this. You made my day, kid!
records.translation: Aba, lintik... Hindi ko inasahang makatanggap ng ganitong regalo. Pinasaya mo ang araw ko, bata!

records.source: Looks like there's some unique fish swimmin' around. Next time I'll have to bring my pole!
records.translation: Mukhang may mga natatanging isdang lumalangoy rito. Sa susunod, dadalhin ko ang pamingwit ko!

records.source: Heh... Willy gave us each a piece of his fish jerky on the ride over. Delicious!
records.translation: Heh... Binigyan kami ni Willy ng tig-isang piraso ng pinatuyong isda habang papunta rito. Ang sarap!

records.source: I'll really miss that girl...$s#$b#You treat my Penny good, now. You hear me?$u
records.translation: Talagang mami-miss ko ang anak kong iyon...$s#$b#Tratuhin mo nang mabuti ang Penny ko, ha. Narinig mo ako?$u

records.source: So, you married the Mullner boy, huh?#$b#Will you be takin' that smelly old dog with ya, too?
records.translation: Kaya, pinakasalan mo ang batang Mullner, ha?#$b#Isasama mo rin ba ang mabahong matandang asong iyon?

records.source: It's a sign from the Almighty... We're doomed...%noturn$s
records.translation: Tanda ito mula sa Maykapal... Katapusan na natin...%noturn$s

records.source: Well, I guess the end-times haven't come just yet, kid...#$e#Ah well, back to the ol' nine to five...
records.translation: Aba, mukhang hindi pa pala dumating ang katapusan ng mundo, bata...#$e#Hay naku, balik na naman sa trabaho mula alas-nuwebe hanggang alas-singko...

records.source: I think these rains are a show of force... a warning.#$b#You could say it's from nature, from Yoba, whatever you like... but that's what I think.#$e#What I mean is, we can't get too cocky. Or else, instead of a green rain, maybe we'll have a blood-red rain... See what I mean?
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, pagpapakita ng lakas ang mga ulang ito... isang babala.#$b#Puwede mong sabihing mula ito sa kalikasan, kay Yoba, o anuman ang gusto mo... pero iyan ang palagay ko.#$e#Ang ibig kong sabihin, hindi tayo puwedeng maging masyadong kampante. Kung hindi, baka sa halip na berdeng ulan, ulang kasimpula ng dugo ang bumagsak... Naiintindihan mo?

records.source: Penny came home crying... what'd you do to her?$3
records.translation: Umuwi si Penny na umiiyak... ano ang ginawa mo sa kanya?$3

records.source: Heard you got a fish pond built... Heh, I grew up with a fish pond.#$b#You can raise just about anything in one of those... But some of the fancier fish are real fussy!
records.translation: Narinig kong nagpagawa ka ng Lawa ng Isda... Heh, lumaki akong may Lawa ng Isda.#$b#Halos kahit ano ay puwede mong alagaan diyan... Pero napakapihikan ng ilang mamahaling isda!

records.source: Alright, alright... you beat me fair and square at the fishing event, kid.#$e#Hmm... maybe my problem was using that beer-battered mushroom as bait...$u
records.translation: Sige na nga... tinalo mo ako nang patas sa paligsahan sa pangingisda, bata.#$e#Hmm... baka ang problema ko ay iyong kabuteng binalot sa harinang may serbesa na ginawa kong pain...$u

records.source: Now this is comfort! I might even take my shoes off!$h#$e#Better not look too closely at my feet, kid.
records.translation: Ito ang tunay na kaginhawahan! Baka hubarin ko pa ang sapatos ko!$h#$e#Huwag mo na lang masyadong tingnan ang mga paa ko, bata.

records.source: It's a special occasion, kid... I'm ordering something unique. Make it a double!$h
records.translation: Espesyal na okasyon ito, bata... Oorder ako ng kakaiba. Doblehin mo!$h

records.source: Wow, would you look at that... It's like something out of the future.#$b#Hehe, sorry kid... I can't use that. There's more buttons than I have brain cells!$h
records.translation: Aba, tingnan mo nga iyan... Parang galing sa hinaharap.#$b#Hehe, pasensiya na, bata... Hindi ko iyan magagamit. Mas marami pa iyang pindutan kaysa sa mga selula ng utak ko!$h

records.source: I can't believe you bought me a house! Is there any catch?#$e#Sorry, I'm not used to people being so nice...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang binilhan mo ako ng bahay! May kapalit ba ito?#$e#Pasensiya na, hindi ako sanay na ganito kabait ang mga tao...$s

records.source: I'm loving the new house. Thanks again, kid!$h
records.translation: Gustong-gusto ko ang bagong bahay. Salamat ulit, bata!$h

records.source: I can't believe someone bought me a house! I wonder if it's some kind of scam?#$e#Sorry, I'm not used to people being so nice...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang may bumili ng bahay para sa akin! Baka panloloko ito?#$e#Pasensiya na, hindi ako sanay na ganito kabait ang mga tao...$s

records.source: Date night with ol' Pam, huh? Hah!$h^Ladies night with ol' Pam, huh? Hah!$h#$b#Sure thing, kid... I'll see you there.
records.translation: Gabi ng pakikipagtipan kasama ang matandang Pam, ano? Hah!$h^Gabi ng mga babae kasama ang matandang Pam, ano? Hah!$h#$b#Sige, bata... Magkita tayo roon.

records.source: Hey, did you hear about the ol' bus?#$b#Yep... I'm back on the saddle, kid... hehe. Feels nice.$h
records.translation: Uy, nabalitaan mo ba ang tungkol sa lumang bus?#$b#Oo... balik na ako sa timon, bata... hehe. Ang sarap sa pakiramdam.$h

records.source: #$1 PamDrank#Urghh... my head...$k#$e#You know, I'd eat healthier food if I could afford it.#$e#Hey, you probably have a lot of tasty grub growin' on your farm, hm?
records.translation: #$1 PamDrank#Aray... ang ulo ko...$k#$e#Alam mo, mas masustansiyang pagkain sana ang kakainin ko kung kaya ko lang itong bilhin.#$e#Uy, malamang maraming masarap na pagkaing tumutubo sa bukid mo, ano?

records.source: Nothin' like a sip o' the good stuff to warm these old bones...$h
records.translation: Walang tatalo sa isang lagok ng matapang na inumin para painitin ang mga buto ko...$h

records.source: Ah... Finally./I need a drink./Gus! Gimme the usual./Hey, I'm back!/Ooh boy, am I thirsty!/I'm parched!
records.translation: Ah... Sa wakas./Kailangan ko ng inumin./Gus! Iyong dati./Uy, nandito na ulit ako!/Naku, uhaw na uhaw ako!/Tuyong-tuyo ang lalamunan ko!

records.source: Penny! Did you make dinner?/Penny! You done your chores?/Penny! You home?/Hey! I'm home!
records.translation: Penny! Nagluto ka ba ng hapunan?/Penny! Tapos ka na ba sa mga gawain mo?/Penny! Nandiyan ka ba?/Uy! Nandito na ako!

records.source: Hey, kid. I'd buy you a drink if I could afford it!
records.translation: Uy, bata. Ililibre sana kita ng inumin kung may pera lang ako!

records.source: Hey Gus! Gimme another round! *hic*$h
records.translation: Uy, Gus! Isa pang tagay! *sinok*$h

records.source: *Sigh*... Hey, kid. You're too young to be moping around in a place like this.
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Uy, bata. Masyado ka pang bata para magmukmok sa ganitong lugar.

records.source: *gulp* ... I've been looking forward to this beverage all afternoon. Heh heh.
records.translation: *lagok* ... Buong hapon kong hinihintay ang inuming ito. Heh heh.

records.source: Oi, Gus! Gimme another pint of your strongest!
records.translation: Hoy, Gus! Isa pang pinta ng pinakamatapang mong inumin!

records.source: %Pam isn't responding.
records.translation: %Hindi sumasagot si Pam.

records.source: %Pam seems out of it. Better leave her alone right now.
records.translation: %Parang wala sa sarili si Pam. Mabuting hayaan muna siyang mag-isa.

records.source: Hey, you! Don't be snoopin' around the trailer when I'm out. Got it?$u#$e#Sorry, but I gotta be cautious with strangers.
records.translation: Uy, ikaw! Huwag kang maghalungkat sa treyler kapag wala ako. Maliwanag?$u#$e#Pasensiya na, pero kailangan kong mag-ingat sa mga estranghero.

records.source: I was reading the newspaper this morning but then I got depressed. It's a rotten world, kid.#$e#Keep your head screwed on right and you'll make it through in one piece...#$b#That's what my Pappy always used to say. Heh heh heh.$h
records.translation: Nagbabasa ako ng diyaryo kaninang umaga pero nalungkot lang ako. Bulok ang mundong ito, bata.#$e#Panatilihin mong maayos ang pag-iisip mo at malalampasan mo ito nang ligtas...#$b#Iyan ang laging sinasabi ng Tatay ko noon. Heh heh heh.$h

records.source: $d bus#You don't know how glad I am that the bus is up and running! I feel alive again.|Times have been tough lately. I got laid off of my job as a bus driver. If I got that job back I could drive you to Calico Desert.
records.translation: $d bus#Hindi mo alam kung gaano ako kasaya na umaandar na ulit ang bus! Para akong nabuhay muli.|Mahirap ang mga panahon nitong huli. Tinanggal ako sa trabaho bilang drayber ng bus. Kung maibabalik ko ang trabahong iyon, maihahatid kita sa Disyerto ng Calico.

records.source: #$1 PamDrunk#Blahh... I had one too many caramel porters at the saloon last night... Go away.$k#$e#My house ain't pretty but at least it's by the river.#$e#Hey. Penny's my baby girl. Be nice to her or leave her alone, got it?
records.translation: #$1 PamDrunk#Aray... naparami ang inom ko ng caramel porter sa saloon kagabi... Umalis ka.$k#$e#Hindi maganda ang bahay ko pero nasa tabi naman ito ng ilog.#$e#Uy. Nag-iisa kong anak na babae si Penny. Maging mabait ka sa kanya o layuan mo siya, malinaw?

records.source: Penny says I spend too much time at the saloon...$s
records.translation: Sabi ni Penny, sobra raw ang oras na ginugugol ko sa saloon...$s

records.source: It's awful lonely at home all by myself...
records.translation: Napakalungkot sa bahay kapag mag-isa lang ako...

records.source: You know, I've been thinking... I wish I had a hobby. Something to do other than hanging around at that saloon every night.#$e#You got any ideas?#$e#...Ehh. Maybe I'll play checkers against myself.
records.translation: Alam mo, napag-iisip-isip ko... Sana may libangan ako. Isang bagay na magagawa bukod sa pagtambay sa saloon gabi-gabi.#$e#May maiisip ka ba?#$e#...Ehh. Baka maglaro na lang ako ng dama laban sa sarili ko.

records.source: Each day's just the same as the last...$s#$b#If only I'd been born rich...$s
records.translation: Pareho lang ang bawat araw sa nauna...$s#$b#Kung ipinanganak lang sana akong mayaman...$s

records.source: Make sure your boots are clean before you go stompin' around in my house.$u#$e#It's annoying to clean a mess. You should know that by now.
records.translation: Tiyaking malinis ang bota mo bago ka maglakad nang padabog sa bahay ko.$u#$e#Nakakainis maglinis ng kalat. Dapat alam mo na iyan.

records.source: I wish a team of elves would come during the night and tidy up my house. Hahahaha.$h#$e#I could sure go for some parsnips.#$e#If my legs weren't so stiff I'd visit the mountains every now and then.
records.translation: Sana may pangkat ng mga duwendeng dumating sa gabi at maglinis ng bahay ko. Hahahaha.$h#$e#Gustong-gusto kong makakain ng parsnip.#$e#Kung hindi lang naninigas ang mga binti ko, dadalaw ako sa kabundukan paminsan-minsan.

records.source: Are you friends with Gus? He's a pretty good guy.#$e#He even gives me free beer on my birthday.
records.translation: Kaibigan mo ba si Gus? Mabuting tao siya.#$e#Binibigyan pa niya ako ng libreng serbesa tuwing kaarawan ko.

records.source: Hey, watch your mouth! No one tells me what to do!$u
records.translation: Hoy, mag-ingat ka sa sinasabi mo! Walang nag-uutos sa akin!$u

records.source: ...it isn't? That's terrible!$s#$b#...Oh.$s
records.translation: ...hindi pala? Napakasama naman!$s#$b#...Ah.$s

records.source: Hi, stranger.
records.translation: Uy, estranghero.

records.source: Oh, it's Mr. @.^Oh it's Miss @.#$e#Do you need my help or something?
records.translation: Ah, si G. @ pala.^Ah, si Bb. @ pala.#$e#Kailangan mo ba ng tulong ko o ano?

records.source: I had hopes and dreams like you, once... But look at me now.$s#$e#Life doesn't always turn out like you expect.#$e#Ah well. There's no sense dwellin' on what you don't have.
records.translation: Mayroon din akong mga pag-asa at pangarap na gaya ng sa iyo noon... Pero tingnan mo ako ngayon.$s#$e#Hindi laging nangyayari sa buhay ang inaasahan mo.#$e#Hay naku. Walang saysay ang pag-iisip nang paulit-ulit sa wala sa iyo.

records.source: Havin' a local farm is good for our town.
records.translation: Mabuti para sa bayan natin ang magkaroon ng bukid dito.

records.source: Maybe if you do real well on your farm it'll boost the local economy.#$e#Then everyone will have a job and we'll all be happy, right?
records.translation: Baka kung mapahusay mo nang husto ang bukid mo, sisigla ang ekonomiya rito.#$e#Tapos, magkakaroon ng trabaho ang lahat at magiging masaya tayong lahat, tama?

records.source: Oh, hi there, farmer.#$e#I don't often chit-chat with strangers.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta, magsasaka.#$e#Hindi ako madalas makipagkuwentuhan sa mga estranghero.

records.source: I always seem to end up at the saloon at some point.#$e#It's too close to my house. It ain't healthy.
records.translation: Parang lagi akong napapadpad sa saloon kalaunan.#$e#Masyado itong malapit sa bahay ko. Hindi iyon mabuti para sa akin.

records.source: ...Yeah?#$e#You're a fine lookin' young man. Why're you wastin' your time talkin' to an old girl like me?^You're a pretty gal. What're you wastin' your time talkin' to someone like me for?
records.translation: ...Ano iyon?#$e#Makisig kang binata. Bakit ka nag-aaksaya ng oras sa pakikipag-usap sa matandang babaeng tulad ko?^Maganda kang dalaga. Bakit ka nag-aaksaya ng oras sa pakikipag-usap sa matandang tulad ko?

records.source: Don't mind that ol' dog next to the house.#$b#He might look at you cross, but he'll never get up from that box in a hunderd years.#$b#The old boy's name? It's Dusty.
records.translation: Huwag mong intindihin ang matandang aso sa tabi ng bahay.#$b#Baka masama siyang tumingin sa iyo, pero hindi siya tatayo mula sa kahong iyon kahit lumipas pa ang sandaang taon.#$b#Ang pangalan ng matandang asong iyon? Dusty.

records.source: Someone's been complainin' about my yard... sayin' it's a mess. Was it you?$u#$e#Hmmm...
records.translation: May nagrereklamo tungkol sa bakuran ko... magulo raw. Ikaw ba iyon?$u#$e#Hmmm...

records.source: If I knew you better, I'd be more inclined to chat.
records.translation: Kung mas kilala lang kita, baka mas makipagkuwentuhan ako.

records.source: I used to be young, once. Hard to believe, huh?#$e#Time sure goes fast when you grow up.$s
records.translation: Naging bata rin ako noon. Mahirap paniwalaan, ano?#$e#Kaybilis talaga ng panahon kapag tumatanda ka.$s

records.source: *Sigh*... I guess I'll be popping a frozen dinner into the microwave tonight.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Mukhang mag-iinit na lang ako ng handa nang hapunan mula sa freezer ngayong gabi.$s

records.source: Penny's the only one I've got, so you best treat her kindly.
records.translation: Si Penny lang ang mayroon ako, kaya dapat pakitunguhan mo siya nang mabuti.

records.source: Every day is the same old routine...$s#$e#Do you ever have that problem, farmer?
records.translation: Pareho lang ang rutina araw-araw...$s#$e#Nagkakaganiyan ka rin ba, magsasaka?

records.source: Would you do me a kindness and clean up my house?#$e#Just kidding.$h
records.translation: Puwede mo ba akong pagbigyan at linisin ang bahay ko?#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako.$h

records.source: Don't you have work to do?#$e#You should be thankful that you have a job rather than moping around town all the time.
records.translation: Wala ka bang trabahong dapat gawin?#$e#Dapat magpasalamat ka na may trabaho ka sa halip na palaging magmukmok sa bayan.

records.source: I miss my old truck driving job. I used to go all around the valley, meetin' people, listenin' to the radio.#$e#Times sure do change.
records.translation: Nami-miss ko ang dati kong trabaho bilang drayber ng trak. Nakakapunta ako noon sa buong lambak, nakakakilala ng mga tao, at nakikinig sa radyo.#$e#Talagang nagbabago ang panahon.

records.source: You got any hogs on that farm?
records.translation: May mga baboy ka ba sa bukid na iyon?

records.source: Do you want somethin' from me, kid? Best look somewhere else.
records.translation: May kailangan ka ba sa akin, bata? Mabuting maghanap ka sa iba.

records.source: I just hope Penny has a good life ahead of her. If you ever have kids you'll know how I feel.#$e#...It's so dry in winter. My skin feels like old parchment.
records.translation: Umaasa lang akong maganda ang buhay na naghihintay kay Penny. Kapag nagkaanak ka, malalaman mo ang nararamdaman ko.#$e#...Napakatuyo kapag taglamig. Parang lumang pergamino ang balat ko.

records.source: Hey. You better be treatin' Penny right on that old farm of yours. She's the only one I got!
records.translation: Uy. Dapat tratuhin mo nang tama si Penny sa lumang bukid mong iyon. Siya lang ang mayroon ako!

records.source: Hey kid. What're you up to?#$e#I'm just passin' time, same as always.
records.translation: Uy, bata. Ano ang pinagkakaabalahan mo?#$e#Nagpapalipas lang ako ng oras, gaya ng dati.

records.source: It's awful cold. A visit to the saloon should warm me up, don't you think? Heh heh.#$e#Why don't you swing by the saloon later for a taste o' the Oh-Be-Joyful?
records.translation: Napakalamig. Mapapainit ako sa pagpunta sa saloon, sa tingin mo? Heh heh.#$e#Bakit hindi ka dumaan sa saloon mamaya para tumikim ng Pampasaya?

records.source: Penny sure does like old books. I think she's a heck of a lot smarter than I ever was.#$e#I'm glad.
records.translation: Talagang mahilig si Penny sa mga lumang aklat. Sa tingin ko, di-hamak na mas matalino siya kaysa sa akin.#$e#Natutuwa ako.

records.source: I oughta take up fishin', seein' as how close the river is.
records.translation: Dapat siguro akong magsimulang mangisda, dahil napakalapit ng ilog.

records.source: Blah... my front yard's a mess.$s
records.translation: Hay... magulo ang bakuran sa harap ng bahay ko.$s
